scientific_scope: GLORYS12V1 assimilates ocean observations; the drifter replay is not guaranteed statistically held out
WAVERYS assimilates significant wave height and uses GLORYS12 currents in its wave calculation
one-times surface Stokes response, object leeway, diffusivity, recovery kernels, and beaching-to-discovery delays are sensitivities rather than jointly out-of-sample calibrated parameters
the persistent GLORYS12/WAVERYS support-mask union distinguishes land encounter but is not a measured shoreline or calibrated beaching, retention, or refloating model
this family remains separate from native HYCOM and GDP; no subjective family weight or pooled surface is reported
This is a diagnostic conditional sensitivity, not an admitted or calibrated crash-location posterior.
Recovery terms retain the source model's evidence powers, numerical floors and profiled object-response assumptions. No new floor or debris transport simulation is introduced.
All evidence subsets use the same source-cell support and numerical-status mask. Unsupported likelihoods remain uncomputed, not neutral likelihood or physical exclusions.
Source prior weights are removed. The per-cell sum of selected log compatibility terms is applied exactly once to the saved flight/impact weights.
The recovery-only and leave-one-out cases exclude isotope and Australian coastal non-recovery terms. Australian coastal debris non-recovery is distinct from seabed search non-detection.
The exterior-only comparison removes the two interior panels; it does not change the windage or Stokes response of the retained objects.
Source stability and calibration limitations are inherited; no source acceptance check is newly passed by removing evidence.
Leave-one-recovery-out changes show sensitivity within this fixed model. They are not independent validation, additive causal contributions, or evidence that a recovered object is wrongly identified.
Family decision diagnostic_only failed: out_of_support_termination, eventwise_arrival_ess, seed_and_particle_stability.
This release exposes the source surface only as an explicitly enabled conditional sensitivity; it does not change the central posterior.
Parent terminal family openap2020-positive-lift-3-targets, contact case r600-no-startup-offset; parent source already includes the cruise, fuel and selected final-contact weights exactly once.

Spatial comparison conditions on computed impacts. Parent incoming mass with uncomputed contact likelihood: 0.030506420888181465; computed impact mass within scored support: 0.9381342735149454. These unresolved masses are not evidence against their locations.
One terminal Monte Carlo seed is used here; its 6 cruise source populations are already pooled with their recorded effort and normalizers. No new equal-weight pool or legacy handoff is fabricated.
Out-of-support parent mass 0.000000 is removed only by the explicit 'condition_on_native_support' sensitivity condition; it is not evidence against those particles.

No extra likelihood floor is added. Source numerical underflow is preserved and is not evidence of physical impossibility. Floors already present in source observation models remain source assumptions.
This branch is deliberately separate from the parent SATCOM/impact posterior and cannot be stacked with another family representing the same observations.

Conditional weight effective row count is 39.62; it measures concentration, not independent flight ancestry or calibrated uncertainty. Independent numerical repeats are required to assess sampling variation.
